caption_L1: Here a bar chart is called Crime clearance rate in the United States in 2019 , by type. The x-axis plots Type of crime while the y-axis shows Percent of offenses cleared by arrest.
caption_L2L3: The trend of this chart tells us that more serious crimes are a larger issue in the USA than more petty ones, that lead to arrests. The more serious crimes are more likely to be followed up by the authorities than the less serious crimes, so will lead to more arrests.
